data.name: Alchemist Defender VR
data.detailed_description:
TreeView Studio's Alchemist Defender VR is a tower defense strategy game designed from ground up to be enjoyed on high end Virtual Reality devices. The game balances tower defense mechanics with intense first person combat using melee and ranged weapons.

Take on the role of a Master Alchemist who after years of researching and crafting tools to find the Philosopher's Stone, have invented a portal to new worlds. The energy of those lands will fuel your final journey to reach the Stone.

To your surprise you are confronted by a rebellion in each world you plan to consume. Now in the midst of glory only a final resistance stands between the Alchemist and absolute power.

Will you be able to stand your ground and dominate those who resist?

Key Features


  • Carefully balanced tower defense game-play.
  • 4 full featured levels.
  • Each level composed of 10 waves of incremental difficulty inspired in the Golden Ratio.
  • Three sets of Turrets: Fast Cannon, Frost and Mortar.
  • VR Diegetic Game UI displayed as the Alchemist Spell Book.
  • Melee first person VR combat using: War Hammer, Spiked Mace, Chain Flail and Ice Sword.
  • Ranged first person combat using Musketoon style firing arm, Explosive Crossbow, Grenade Launcher and Chemthrower.
  • Proximity mine power weapons including explosive blast, chemical shock, ice shot and void hole.
  • Turret relocation.
  • Multi class enemies for each level.

Community


Alchemist Defender VR was launched as Early Access inApril 2007. We have come a long way from the initial Early Access launch to the current live version. We have a Discord Server with all of the Development Team and fellow Alchemists. We would love to discuss any aspects of the game including game design, game balance and bugs through our discord. Just send us a private message to join.

Credits


Developed and published by TreeView Studios

Producer and Developer: Horacio Torrendell
3D Artist and Level Designer: Maximiliano Kossyrczyk
Audio Design, Composer and Video Production: Guillermo Ferres
UI/UX and Game Design: Joaquin Guelfi
Developer: Lucas Szolno
PR: Jesus Fabre

reviews.review:
You can view my review & gameplay here (along with footage of the Unreal Engine Crash at the end): https://youtu.be/V-CnU-AYhqk

[h1]Experienced on the Oculus Rift with Touch Controllers[/h1]

So I saw this game on sale recently for $4.99 USD and I almost pulled the trigger. Then I saw this game as part of a VR bundle and was excited most for this game. Well ... now I'm just happy that I didn't pull the trigger and I'm only out about .50 cents USD versus the $4.99 USD. This game is bad.

However, there are a few nice things about it. First of all, there are 4 beautiful environments to view, especially when you're playing in God mode (over the top mode). Really nice work on these assets. Also, in each of the four levels, you have different classes to play (different weapons) to go along with fighting different enemies. It's neat how you go from placing turrets in God mode, then go first person mode to fight the horde. You can teleport around in first person mode and also snap turn throughout.

Unfortunately, the gameplay itself is horrible. It's dull & repetitive. There's only 3 turrets available: a fast-firing but low damage turret, a slowing & damage ice beam turret, and a slow firing, heavy-damage cannon. There's almost no strategy to placing them. In fact, none of the 4 environments or enemies really matter in what you place down. You almost always want to place down the slowing frost turret. Then the fast turret .... then the cannon if you can afford it. 

In the meantime, you want to place bombs in the back. Then go first person mode whenever you can and just tap the enemies with your melee weapon and they will instantly die. Then go ranged when that's not available and just mindlessly fire at the enemies as much as possible. Rinse & repeat.

None of the combat is exciting because all the enemies just walk towards the portal with no strategy. There's just more of them as you get to the 10th and final wave. Some have bigger health bars than others. There is no enemy AI whatsoever. Thus, the actual gameplay is dull throughout. There is also no story.

So with no story & dull gameplay, there's nothing to do but admire the visuals. Which only really look great in God mode. Unlocking Master mode (first four levels are apprentice mode) does nothing to improve gameplay. And the game crashes ... a lot. During my almost 2 hours of gameplay, I would say the game crashed maybe 5 times. 

[b]Rate 3/10. I'm do disappointed. I have no idea how anyone rated this game positively. Don't trust those reviewers. [/b]

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Requer um sistema operativo e processador de 64 bits
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows 7 SP1 or newer
  • Processador: Intel Core i5 4590 or AMD FX 8350 or greater.
  • Memória: 4 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 290 or better
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 3 GB de espaço livre
  • Compatibilidade com R.V.: SteamVR. Room Scale 2m by 1.5m area required
